asset_name: Megalodon Jaw — 184 Fossil Teeth in Resin Reconstruction

identity.large_tooth_note: Offering materials state that four teeth measure 6.25 inches each.
identity.construction_note: Offering materials state that teeth were collected over years from multiple source organisms and arranged to represent a life-like megalodon dentition.

condition.summary: Full set of fossilized teeth; offering materials describe wear consistent with age and professional preparation.
condition.originality_caveat: The jaw itself is a modern resin reconstruction; the collectible fossil content is the mounted tooth set.

source_notes: Subject specifications and offering information are derived from user-supplied Rally screenshots and offering-document screenshots.
Rally displays the subject as an 8 x 9.5 foot reconstructed jaw containing 184 fossil megalodon teeth.
The offering document uses the legacy genus Carcharocles in places; this file normalizes the taxon to Otodus megalodon while preserving legacy names.
The offering document states that the teeth were selected from multiple source organisms and mounted in a resin reconstruction.
The offering document states that the preparator had been featured on National Geographic Channel's Predators.
